title: Product and Journey Catalog
description: Record, query and assess product intent, implementation and evidence.

intents.title: author catalog records
intents.outcome: Use PJC to author product contracts and their evidence.

journeys.title: Author catalog records
journeys.situation: A contributor needs to describe or revise product behavior in the catalog.
journeys.outcome: Use PJC to author product contracts and their evidence.

existingBehavior: Existing FlowDAG and journey pilot remain available.
invariants: Declarations are not proof of implementation or authority.

observations.title: Existing flow registry
observations.statement: The existing FlowDAG registry remains separate from PJC records.

impacts.title: Catalog authoring impact
impacts.statement: Changes to record definitions affect the loader, validation, CLI and catalog modules.

platformDifferences.title: Repository tooling
platformDifferences.statement: Contributors edit repository files and use a Node CLI; the catalog has no browser or native authoring interface.

steps.title: Edit catalog records
steps.interaction: Inspect existing records and edit the appropriate feature module.

steps.title: Inspect result
steps.interaction: Review the authored records and validate them with the catalog checker.

transitions.title: author operation
transitions.feedback: Validation reports errors and remaining gaps.

scenarios.title: author catalog
scenarios.expected: The contributor edits the appropriate module and reviews validation errors and gaps.

requirements.title: Validate authored records
requirements.statement: Authored feature modules must be checked for the supported hierarchy, unique IDs and valid references.

requirements.title: Truthful coverage
requirements.statement: An implementation reference or evidence declaration is not proof of runtime behavior.

bindings.title: Catalog checks
bindings.note: Checks declarations; it does not execute product journeys.

bindings.title: Platform-neutral PJC entry point
bindings.note: Exposes schema validation and journey projection; filesystem loading remains separate.

bindings.title: Existing flow registry
bindings.note: Existing FlowDAG registry; presence is not application journey evidence.

bindings.title: Catalog tests
bindings.note: Tests are references, not execution evidence.

bindings.title: PJC CLI tests
bindings.note: Exercises CLI contracts using fixture catalogs; a test file is not execution evidence.

intents.title: query catalog records
intents.outcome: Use PJC to query product contracts and their evidence.

journeys.title: Find catalog records
journeys.situation: A contributor needs to locate relevant product records.
journeys.outcome: Use PJC to query product contracts and their evidence.

observations.title: Existing query commands
observations.statement: The CLI provides list and inspect commands for catalog records.

impacts.title: Query consumers
impacts.statement: Changes to query filters or projections affect contributors and agents consuming CLI output.

platformDifferences.title: CLI query surface
platformDifferences.statement: Query output is generated by the repository CLI as JSON, text or Markdown.

existingBehavior: The PJC CLI reads the versioned catalog.
invariants: Declarations are not proof of implementation or authority.

steps.title: Review query result
steps.interaction: Read the returned records and their declared context.

transitions.title: query operation
transitions.action: Run list or inspect with the desired filters.
transitions.feedback: The CLI returns matching records or a specific error.

scenarios.title: query catalog
scenarios.expected: The CLI returns matching records or a specific error.

requirements.title: Find and inspect catalog records
requirements.statement: A contributor can list and filter records, inspect an ID in minimal or expanded form, and receive an error for an unknown ID.

intents.title: trace catalog records
intents.outcome: Use PJC to trace product contracts and their evidence.

journeys.title: Trace catalog records
journeys.situation: A contributor needs to follow an implementation or requirement back to product intent.
journeys.outcome: Use PJC to trace product contracts and their evidence.

observations.title: Existing trace command
observations.statement: The CLI traces catalog IDs and implementation references.

impacts.title: Trace consumers
impacts.statement: Changes to relationship indexing or traversal affect traces from catalog IDs and implementation references.

platformDifferences.title: CLI trace surface
platformDifferences.statement: Trace reads the repository catalog through the CLI; it does not inspect a running application.

existingBehavior: The PJC CLI reads the versioned catalog.
invariants: Declarations are not proof of implementation or authority.

steps.title: Prepare trace
steps.interaction: Choose a record ID or implementation reference.

steps.title: Review trace result
steps.interaction: Inspect incoming, outgoing and related catalog records.

transitions.title: trace operation
transitions.action: Run trace with the record ID or reference.
transitions.feedback: The CLI returns linked records or a specific error.

scenarios.title: trace catalog
scenarios.expected: The CLI returns linked records or a specific error.

requirements.title: Trace catalog relationships
requirements.statement: A contributor can trace a catalog ID or implementation reference to its incoming, outgoing and related records.

intents.title: validate catalog records
intents.outcome: Use PJC to validate product contracts and their evidence.

journeys.title: Validate catalog records
journeys.situation: A contributor needs to identify invalid records and outstanding evidence gaps.
journeys.outcome: Use PJC to validate product contracts and their evidence.

observations.title: Existing catalog checker
observations.statement: The CLI check reports schema errors and declared gaps without executing application journeys.

impacts.title: Validation consumers
impacts.statement: Changes to schema or reference validation affect catalog authors and automated check consumers.

platformDifferences.title: CLI validation surface
platformDifferences.statement: The CLI checks repository-local references; other route and remote-source behavior remains unverifiable.

existingBehavior: The PJC CLI reads the versioned catalog.
invariants: Declarations are not proof of implementation or authority.

steps.title: Prepare validate
steps.interaction: Choose the catalog and an optional revision.

steps.title: Review validate result
steps.interaction: Review validation errors, binding checks and evidence gaps.

transitions.title: validate operation
transitions.feedback: The CLI returns validation errors or a report of declared gaps.

scenarios.title: validate catalog
scenarios.expected: The CLI returns validation errors or a report of declared gaps.

requirements.title: Report catalog errors and gaps
requirements.statement: Catalog checks reject invalid structure and references and report implementation and evidence gaps without claiming runtime proof.
